nodes.title: 保存V2｜加速飞行_绝不施法
Turbo Sampler｜自动适配当前H3调度
H3 Ref2VA INT8｜支持图与动作视频参考

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the single chibi little witch in reference image 1: oversized ivory floppy pointed hat with dark-purple underside, one blue bow and the original black rectangular eyes, inverted-V mouth and pink cheeks painted on the hat; pale blonde bangs, two braids with blue ties, simple vertical black oval eyes, tiny closed mouth, dark-purple dress with lavender hem and blue neck bow, short legs and purple boots. Preserve the original soft pastel, softly shaded storybook illustration and chibi proportions.
<Subject 2> is her single brown broom, with golden bristles and a blue binding on screen-left, its handle pointing screen-right.
<Subject 3> is the single brown wand with an ivory mascot topper. It is a completely inert handheld prop with fixed matte colors and constant brightness. The topper's face is painted decoration.

summary:
[reference generation] Produce ONLY a broom-riding flight movement for <Subject 1>, with no casting action at any time. Five-second reusable character asset, 768x768, 24fps, one uninterrupted full-body shot on flat opaque chroma green #00FF00. Generate 124 frames and deliver the first 120. Show one readable transition from relaxed cruising into a compact forward-leaning fast-flight posture, then sustain the faster posture. This is an acceleration action, not a looping idle.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - face, hat design, outfit, two braids, short limbs, palette, proportions and illustration style. Only the specified flying body mechanics and restrained wind response may change.
<Subject 2> (throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - one solid broom with unchanged shape, orientation and binding; hips remain seated in continuous contact with its shaft.
<Subject 3> (throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - same single rigid prop, both hands maintaining the original low diagonal grip against the torso. The wand tip stays close to the body, with no separate hand, wrist or arm gesture. Its surface and topper remain matte and unlit for the entire shot.
Reference image 1 defines only identity, pose, props and rendering. Replace the gray background with flat chroma green from the very first output frame. Do not use the source as a literal gray first frame.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1 | 0.000-5.167s | reference image 1]
Fixed camera and fixed scale, original three-quarter view facing screen-right. Keep the whole hat tip, both braids, both boots, wand, broom handle and bristles inside the frame with at least 8% green margin. The group remains centered; flight speed is communicated through body pitch and wind response. The view stays the same with no cuts or camera movement. Do not reserve an area for a wand performance. The hands and wand form one quiet compact unit against the torso and move only together with the torso. Eyes remain calmly looking forward and the mouth remains closed.

Action timeline:
0.000-0.750s: calm upright cruising like the steady-flight version, seated on a nearly horizontal broom; low airflow in the braid ends and skirt edge. Both hands hold the inert wand quietly against the torso.
0.750-2.250s: accelerate once. Keep the pelvis seated at the same contact point and progressively hinge the upper body forward toward screen-right by about 10 degrees. Tilt the entire broom-and-rider assembly forward by about 3 degrees, without rolling or turning toward the camera. Bring the elbows closer to the ribs and let the two boots tuck slightly backward together under the seat, without pedaling. The held wand follows the torso as one quiet unit; neither hand lifts or flicks it. The two braid ends, floppy hat tip, skirt edge and bristle tips progressively extend farther toward screen-left under the stronger airflow. Preserve all prop lengths and body proportions.
2.250-4.500s: maintain the compact forward-leaning fast-flight posture. The airflow holds the hair and loose fabric swept backward with small controlled flutter. Reduce vertical hovering compared with calm flight so the ride feels streamlined and fast. Keep a stable seated contact, both boots together, head aligned with the leaning torso and eyes looking forward. No repeated acceleration pulse, bouncing, kicking or arm gesture.
4.500-5.000s: continue at the higher speed with the same forward lean and backward-swept hair and fabric. Do not brake, return upright, or add an ending gesture. This ends in sustained fast flight and is not forced to loop to the opening pose.
5.000-5.167s: maintain the same fast-flight posture; this buffer is trimmed.

Absolute flight-only rule: no wand lift, pointing, flicking, waving, drawing a circle, casting pose, charging, release or recoil. ZERO visible spell effects in EVERY frame: no emitting light from the wand, hat, body or broom; no flashes, sparkles, stars, particles, glowing core, aura, beam, energy ribbon, trail, smoke, dust, speed lines or detached decorative marks. The wand topper keeps exactly its original non-emissive painted appearance, without any brightening. Nothing may appear around the wand tip. The only visible elements are the original witch, broom, inert wand and uniform green background.

Background and stability: fully opaque uniform #00FF00, no gray fade, scenery, floor, horizon, shadow, gradient, changing exposure, green spill, wind graphics or motion blur. Stable soft diffuse lighting and original local colors. Preserve exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two braids; no extra props, limbs, long legs, pedaling, walking, body sliding, changing grips, duplicated broom, bent wand, live hat face, live topper face, lip movement, text, subtitle or watermark. Preserve silhouette and color blocks without flicker.

overall_soundscape:
Silent output.

non_diegetic_music:
None.

widgets_values:
# 小魔女 01B · 加速飞行_绝不施法 · V2

0–0.75秒平稳巡航；0.75–2.25秒身体逐渐前倾、双肘收紧、双脚一起稍向后收，辫子、帽尖、裙摆和扫帚尾随气流向后展开；2.25–5秒保持前倾高速姿态，减少上下浮动。全程不抬杖、不挥杖、不发光，不添加速度线或粒子；结尾保持高速，不强行回到起始姿态。

修复：移除V1共用提示中对星光、能量核心和魔杖表演空间的描述；纯飞行魔杖为不发光静态道具，双手全程相对躯干固定。

模型、参考图、尺寸768×768、124帧采样→120帧/24fps、Turbo6与V1相同。只有动作提示、说明与新输出前缀改变。

只修改并准备；用户手动运行，本轮没有生成视频。生成后核对：是否仍有发光/施法，平稳与加速姿态是否清楚不同。
输出：outputs/comfyui/witch_flight_green_v2/01B_加速飞行_绝不施法
